owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) — CC gates writes. Name descriptive (it INSPECTS the diagnostic breadcrumbs — reacts to a callback, filters the log, produces findings); the CLI face would be `cairn diagnose <pointer>`, the least-used secondary access path.
remit: THE EXPLICIT REMIT (Akien, verbatim): 'Its job is to save you tokens in exploring the issue in the same way the prebuild step does for coding. And to keep getting better over time.' The inspector is the DEBUGGING ANALOG OF PREBUILD — it pre-processes a red so CC (the expensive resolver) spends tokens only on the novel diagnosis, never on a second exploration for data the first pass should have carried (Law 1, the cocoon). 'Gets better over time' is monotonic + physical: every learned gap is one fewer second-exploration forever.
intention: THE DIAGNOSTIC INSPECTOR, factored (Akien) as the three parts of the diagnostic surface: (1) LOGGING — gates emit thin microsecond-stamped breadcrumbs (cairn/base/diagnostic.py); state, so its durable home is instance-space (~/.cairn/, cache-class json log; the in-memory Mailbox is a v0 proof STAND-IN, not the runtime home). (2) CALLBACK — a watched thing (a red, a watched gate-contact) FIRES 'inspect now' (event, not poll). (3) INSPECTOR — reacts to the callback: applies FILTERS (predicates, conjoined — by_pointer the primary, by_gate composing; by_time_band/by_severity filed) to the log and produces FINDINGS: the ordered, isolated transaction slice (every emitted value carried, source deep-copied never mutated) PLUS the COMPLETENESS finding — json whose entire audience is CC. PLUS the LEARNING-LOOP the inspector CARRIES: when the findings prove insufficient (a gap forced a second exploration), record_miss folds that gap into what the class's next findings must carry — so the same gap never costs a second exploration again. The emission stays dumb (Law 6, only the pointer crosses); the inspector is where the intelligence AND the learning live (Law 1 — the diagnostic surface's inference compiled once, the inference_domain move). The findings are a transient surface; the RESOLUTION CC produces is the record of truth (Law 7).
why: Instantiates [[I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass]] — findings that resolve it on the first pass, a method Akien has PROVEN over decades (2007 framework, UU, Trouble Tickets; half-day→10min; his first-reach debugging tool). Proven infra, built AHEAD of need. DiagnosticBase.emit (built) is the dumb breadcrumb; this is the smart reader its own docstring named as 'the next build'. The learning-loop makes the findings SELF-TEACHING: it is [[I-learns-its-gates]] pointed at the diagnostic surface — the findings learn their own completeness from the evidence of what they missed, so completeness rises monotonically and no learned gap recurs (exactly the remit's 'gets better over time', made physics).
traces_to: THE REMIT (save CC tokens exploring an issue as prebuild does for coding; get better over time) — Akien-stated, the ticket's own first field
[[I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass]] (the concept-piece this instantiates — the findings deliver all resolve-data on the first pass)

Law 1 (a second exploration to gather more failure data is re-deriving the settled — the waste the complete findings kill; the inspector's inference is compiled ONCE, the cocoon/inference_domain move)
Law 7 SHARPENED (the diagnostic surface is not merely loud but COMPLETE on first emission; a learned recurrence is LOUD; the findings are transient, the RESOLUTION is the record of truth)

Law 6 (the emission stays a thin pointer; the inspector reads and never emits, never copies the ticket, never mutates its source — the dumb-breadcrumb / smart-reader split)

(3) THE LEARNING-LOOP — record_miss on the Inspector folds a first miss forward so the next findings demand it (Law 1); a recurrence of an already-learned gap is complete=False + named LOUD in recurrences (the terminal falsifier). falsifier: the inspector reacts to a callback, filters the breadcrumbs+logs into complete, coherent, isolated FINDINGS for a pointer, and its learning-loop folds each forced-second-exploration's miss into the next findings' completeness. Wrong-shape signals: (1) the findings are INCOMPLETE by construction — drop emitted values or bleed in other pointers' records; (2) FILTERS do not compose — a second filter is ignored so the conjunction is a lie; (3) the learning-loop records a miss but never changes the next findings (learning theater); (4) an already-learned gap recurs and the loop stays SILENT (the terminal falsifier — Law 1 defect, must be loud, Law 7); (5) the inspector grows to EMIT (a second emitter, collapsing the dumb-breadcrumb / smart-reader split — Law 6); (6) it mutates its source records; (7) the learned-completeness store is merged INTO the decision-autonomy gate-store; (8) the inspector runs as a STANDING SCAN rather than reacting to a fired callback (the firehose/poll the shrinking-footprint discipline rejects).
